title: MPESB Revised Exam Calendar 2026
vacancyDetails: Revised annual / quarterly exam schedule for MPESB recruitments and departmental exams in 2026
howToApply:
1. Visit https://esb.mp.gov.in
2. Open Notices / Calendar section
3. Download MPESB Revised Exam Calendar 2026 PDF
4. Note tentative exam months for your post group
5. Watch individual advertisements for exact dates
shortDescription: MPESB Revised Exam Calendar 2026 released. Download updated schedule from esb.mp.gov.in.
content:
Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) has released the Revised Exam Calendar 2026.

The calendar provides tentative timelines for various Group examinations, departmental tests and other MPESB activities during the year. Exact application windows and exam dates are always confirmed through individual advertisements.

How to use the calendar

  • Download the official PDF from esb.mp.gov.in
  • Identify your exam group / post family
  • Plan preparation around tentative months
  • Track live notices for final dates
